model: Case A: costly review with cancellation or capped fallback
scope: Conditional transaction-level comparisons, not an optimal mechanism or observed market frequencies.
cost_timing: eta and kappa are paid whenever review is requested, regardless of timeliness
feasibility: The capped fallback must be preauthorized and executable at the deadline; it cannot recover an already expired opportunity.
tie_rule: Autonomy at agent indifference; user indifference is recorded separately.
interpretation: The main figure is one explicit illustrative profile. The symbolic identities and sensitivity surface establish its conditional scope; plot areas are not probabilities of real transactions.
